note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dry disturbance spreads fine residue. The correct answer refuses the method and refers the material.
Western Australian guidance warns against sweeping or vacuuming ash. A clean look does not show that the residue is gone.

practicalCriteria: The learner keeps residue undisturbed and refuses dry disturbance.
The learner records residue as uncharacterised until a qualified person assesses it.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Residue is disturbed or its composition is unknown.
A dry or high-pressure method is proposed.
